svg.title: Yuxia Xie research overview: connecting biological measurements through interpretable AI
svg.desc: Gene expression and networks, pathology images, and spatial transcriptomics inform interpretable computational methods. Three research directions are xGATE for pathway scoring, xMINT for image and omics integration, and SPACT and SPACT-ST for pathway activity in tumor ecosystems. Tissue panels are from the original xMINT overview. Other graphics are conceptual illustrations.
svg.text: Biological structure · Cross-modal learning · Tissue context
Conceptual research overview · Image panels from the original xMINT figure · SPACT / SPACT-ST: research in development
